description: Returns the dates and UK times of upcoming full, new, first quarter and last quarter Moons, with each full Moon's traditional name, its distance, and supermoon, blue Moon, micromoon and black Moon flags. Special Moons can be listed on their own.

count.description: Maximum number of events, from 1 to 24. 6 without it.

from.description: First UK date to include, as YYYY-MM-DD. Without it the list starts right now.

phase.description: Phase to list: full, new, first-quarter, last-quarter, or any for all four in date order. Any without it.

special.description: Lists only supermoons, blue Moons, micromoons (full Moons) or black Moons (the second new Moon of a month), so it fixes the phase. None, ordinary phases, without it.

to.description: Last UK date to include, as YYYY-MM-DD. Without it the list covers about two years from the start, or up to 2100 for a special Moon.

name: find_moon_events
title: Moon phase dates
